tools.name: set_tax_config
tools.description: Save the user's own tax rules: jurisdiction label, flat rate (%) applied to revenue minus deductible expenses, fiscal year start month, non-deductible categories, partially deductible categories (name -> percent). Never guess a rate; ask.

tools.name: estimate
tools.description: Quarterly estimate from the books (revenue received, deductible expenses by category, taxable amount, estimated tax) plus a before-you-file checklist. quarter like 2026-Q3; default current.

tools.name: build_package
tools.description: Write the accountant package for a quarter to .taxprep/package-<quarter>/: expenses.csv, invoices.csv, summary.md, summary.json.
